result.topic_en: Diary entries from December 1799 to May 1800 on the arithmetic-geometric mean as an integral, reduced ternary forms, convergence of a cosine series, the transcendental integral ∫dx/√((1−αx²)(1−βx²)), and the chronological problem of the date of Easter.
result.transcription:
# [-R-] Medium arithmetico-geometricum tamquam
quotientem duarum functionum transcendentium
repraesentabile[-m-] esse iam pridem inveneramus:
nunc alteram harum functionum ad quantitates
integrales reducibilem esse deteximus. Helmst.
Dec. 14
### Medium Arithmetico-Geometricum ipsum est quanti
tas integralis [-Dem-] Dec. 23
# In theoria formarum ternariarum formas reductas
1800. Febr. 13
assignare contigit
Seriem $a\cos A + a'\cos(A+\varphi) + a''\cos(A+2\varphi) + \text{etc.}$
ad limitem convergit, si $a, a', a''$ etc. constituant pro-
gressionem sine mutatione signi ad 0 continuo con-
vergentem. Demonstratum Brunov. Apr. 27.
#### Theoriam quantitatum transcendentium
$\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{(1-\alpha xx)(1-\beta xx)}}$
ad summam universalitatem perduximus
Brunov. Mai. 6
Incrementum ingens huius theoriae Brunov. Maj. 22
invenire contigit, per quod simul omnia praecedentia
nec non theoria mediorum arithmetico geometricorum pulcher
rime nectuntur infinitiesque augentur.
Iisdem diebus circa (Mai. 16) problema chronologicum
de festo paschalis [-..-] eleganter resolvimus.
Promulg. in Zach's Mon. Corr. Aug. 1800 p. 121 [?]

methods.what: Arithmetic-geometric mean represented as a quotient of two transcendental functions, one of which is reducible to integrals
methods.quote:
Medium arithmetico-geometricum tamquam
quotientem duarum functionum transcendentium
repraesentabile[-m-] esse iam pridem inveneramus:
nunc alteram harum functionum ad quantitates
integrales reducibilem esse deteximus.

methods.what: The arithmetic-geometric mean itself is an integral quantity (elliptic integral)
methods.quote:
Medium Arithmetico-Geometricum ipsum est quanti
tas integralis

methods.what: Determination of reduced forms in the theory of ternary quadratic forms
methods.quote:
In theoria formarum ternariarum formas reductas
assignare contigit

methods.what: Convergence of the series Σ a_n cos(A+nφ) when the coefficients decrease monotonically to 0 without sign change
methods.quote:
Seriem $a\cos A + a'\cos(A+\varphi) + a''\cos(A+2\varphi) + \text{etc.}$
ad limitem convergit, si $a, a', a''$ etc. constituant pro-
gressionem sine mutatione signi ad 0 continuo con-
vergentem.

methods.what: General theory of the elliptic integral ∫dx/√((1−αx²)(1−βx²))
methods.quote:
Theoriam quantitatum transcendentium
$\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{(1-\alpha xx)(1-\beta xx)}}$
ad summam universalitatem perduximus

methods.what: Extension of that theory that connects all the preceding results and the theory of the arithmetic-geometric mean
methods.quote:
Incrementum ingens huius theoriae Brunov. Maj. 22
invenire contigit, per quod simul omnia praecedentia
nec non theoria mediorum arithmetico geometricorum pulcher
rime nectuntur infinitiesque augentur.

methods.what: Solution of the chronological problem of determining the date of Easter
methods.quote:
problema chronologicum
de festo paschalis [-..-] eleganter resolvimus.

items.quote:
nunc alteram harum functionum ad quantitates
integrales reducibilem esse deteximus.
items.english: Now we have discovered that one of these functions is reducible to integral quantities.

items.quote:
Medium Arithmetico-Geometricum ipsum est quanti
tas integralis
items.english: The arithmetic-geometric mean itself is an integral quantity.

items.quote:
In theoria formarum ternariarum formas reductas
assignare contigit
items.english: In the theory of ternary forms we succeeded in assigning the reduced forms.

items.quote:
Seriem $a\cos A + a'\cos(A+\varphi) + a''\cos(A+2\varphi) + \text{etc.}$
ad limitem convergit, si $a, a', a''$ etc. constituant pro-
gressionem sine mutatione signi ad 0 continuo con-
vergentem. Demonstratum
items.english: The series a cos A + a' cos(A+φ) + a'' cos(A+2φ) + etc. converges to a limit if a, a', a'' etc. form a progression that converges continually to 0 without change of sign. Proved.

items.quote:
Theoriam quantitatum transcendentium
$\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{(1-\alpha xx)(1-\beta xx)}}$
ad summam universalitatem perduximus
items.english: We have brought the theory of the transcendental quantities ∫dx/√((1−αxx)(1−βxx)) to the highest generality.

items.quote:
Incrementum ingens huius theoriae Brunov. Maj. 22
invenire contigit, per quod simul omnia praecedentia
nec non theoria mediorum arithmetico geometricorum pulcher
rime nectuntur infinitiesque augentur.
items.english: We succeeded in finding an enormous extension of this theory, by which all the preceding results, and also the theory of arithmetic-geometric means, are most beautifully connected and infinitely enlarged.

items.quote:
problema chronologicum
de festo paschalis [-..-] eleganter resolvimus.
items.english: We elegantly solved the chronological problem of the Easter feast.
